normalize_test_output: normalize Google Test output by removing headers, footers, locations, and memory addresses
remove_report_header_footer: remove Google Test result report header and footer lines from test output text
remove_file_locations: remove file location info like FILE_NAME:LINE_NUMBER from Google Test program output
find_leaky_mock_tests: find and return a list of test names that leak mock objects from output text
run_gmock_output_test: run the gmock output test command and compare normalized output against a golden file
